     * @param value The amount of tokens to be transferred.

     * @param spender The address which will spend the funds.

Manager deposit pulls the chosen whitelisted asset from caller to registry-configured deposit recipient, prices it via NAV and (for non-base asset) configured oracle, applies fee/limits/greenlist checks, then mints net shares. Manager direct deposit requires allowance to Manager instead. The wrapper becomes msg.sender in the downstream Manager deposit and may itself need configured greenlist eligibility; current provisioning is not attested.

requestRedemption is asynchronous: fees may be charged immediately and net shares are locked, not paid out. owner must have unlocked shares; if owner differs from caller, caller needs vault-share allowance (spender is caller, not Manager). Processing is onlyOperator and deliberately excluded: users cannot force completion, payment timing, gasFeeShares, NAV or redemption-source liquidity. Queue index comes from RedemptionRequested/nextQueueIndex, not transaction return value.

cancelRedemption unlocks remaining queued net shares; it does not refund already charged redemption fees or pay assets. Non-owner cancellation spends caller allowance against owner. It lacks global whenNotPaused but still checks vault pause, owner blacklist, registration and queue existence. No user claim/withdraw/redeem exists in the exact Vault implementation, despite generic SDK examples.

Redemption pricing uses current NAV or min(request,current NAV) if MIN_NAV feature enabled, deducts operator-supplied gasFeeShares and settles configured base asset from redemption source. yPrism terms state target T+2, not an on-chain guaranteed maturity; other registered vaults can have different terms. No deadline or caller-set redemption minimum is present. The observed yPrism base asset is PRISM rather than the USDC stated in legal terms; no claim that operator settlement currently pays USDC is made.

Global/vault pauses, blacklists, enabled greenlist/KYC and limits, initialized NAV, redemption enabled status and required allowances remain authoritative. Eligibility excludes U.S. Persons/United States and restricts UK, China and sanctioned jurisdictions; wallet permission does not establish legal eligibility. Instruments are subordinated limited-recourse contractual claims, not ownership of underlying assets.

Current Ethereum YieldFi V3 Manager proxy 0x08fB9833A5a84d5bCEcDF5a4a635d33260C5F05C resolves on Etherscan to 0x948005846961d0813AF1B18d0316214b4b83A2F2; yPrism proxy 0xdd5eff0756db08bad0ff16b66f88f506e7318894 resolves to 0xd3963b0Ae80081a98156fdFC286529c91a19F2Aa. Upgradeability and mutable registry/NAV/oracle/feature wiring remain authoritative.

This admission excludes paused legacy yUSD/vyUSD. Official site explicitly says V3 is live. Explorer read-as-proxy observation binds current yPrism asset() to PRISM 0x06Bb4ab600b7D22eB2c312f9bAbC22Be6a619046 (18 decimals), name() YieldFi OpenEden and manager() to reviewed V3 Manager: direct yPrism deposit therefore uses PRISM, NOT USDC. Official yPrism legal terms still describe USDC settlement and USDC/USDT/USD0 deposits; that document is not substituted for current on-chain configuration. Manager deposit amount uses selected whitelisted asset decimals; all vault shares use 18 decimals. Re-read registry/whitelist/base asset for the chosen vault before use.

Manager deposit pulls the chosen whitelisted asset from caller to registry-configured deposit recipient, prices it via NAV and (for non-base asset) configured oracle, applies fee/limits/greenlist checks, then mints net shares. Set minShares appropriately. bytes32 referralCode is emitted attribution data, not executable calldata. Registration and whitelist checks constrain caller-selected vault/asset to configured YieldFi products; no arbitrary executor is admitted.

Vault deposit pulls its configured base asset to vault, validates caller/receiver, and calls its Manager with minShares=0 and referralCode=0. Caller must approve the vault, while the vault must already have operator-provisioned Manager allowance. No caller-set slippage minimum or deadline exists on this wrapper. Manager direct deposit requires allowance to Manager instead. The wrapper becomes msg.sender in the downstream Manager deposit and may itself need configured greenlist eligibility; current provisioning is not attested.

requestRedemption is asynchronous: fees may be charged immediately and net shares are locked, not paid out. owner must have unlocked shares; if owner differs from caller, caller needs vault-share allowance (spender is caller, not Manager). Processing is onlyOperator and deliberately excluded: users cannot force completion, payment timing, gasFeeShares, NAV or redemption-source liquidity. Queue index comes from RedemptionRequested/nextQueueIndex, not transaction return value.

cancelRedemption unlocks remaining queued net shares; it does not refund already charged redemption fees or pay assets. Non-owner cancellation spends caller allowance against owner. It lacks global whenNotPaused but still checks vault pause, owner blacklist, registration and queue existence. No user claim/withdraw/redeem exists in the exact Vault implementation, despite generic SDK examples.

Redemption pricing uses current NAV or min(request,current NAV) if MIN_NAV feature enabled, deducts operator-supplied gasFeeShares and settles configured base asset from redemption source. yPrism terms state target T+2, not an on-chain guaranteed maturity; other registered vaults can have different terms. No deadline or caller-set redemption minimum is present. The observed yPrism base asset is PRISM rather than the USDC stated in legal terms; no claim that operator settlement currently pays USDC is made.

Global/vault pauses, blacklists, enabled greenlist/KYC and limits, initialized NAV, redemption enabled status and required allowances remain authoritative. Eligibility excludes U.S. Persons/United States and restricts UK, China and sanctioned jurisdictions; wallet permission does not establish legal eligibility. Instruments are subordinated limited-recourse contractual claims, not ownership of underlying assets.

lifecycleEvidence.excerpt: YieldFi V3 is live. Some legacy vaults remain accessible on the previous interface during migration. Current yPRISM product page.
All YieldFi v3 contract addresses on Ethereum Mainnet: Manager V3 0x08fB9833A5a84d5bCEcDF5a4a635d33260C5F05C; Example Vaults yPrism 0xdd5eff0756db08bad0ff16b66f88f506e7318894.

yPrism deposits accepted 24/7; onchain redemption request, target T+2, optional greenlist/KYC and issuer-controlled processing. The USDC/legal-term asset description conflicts with current PRISM base-asset observation and is not used as current configuration evidence.

sourceSemantics.bytes32Interpretation: referralCode is a fixed bytes32 included only in deposit/redemption events, not decoded as target, calldata, signature, permit or callback authorization.
sourceSemantics.SDKMismatch: SDK Vault docs show mint(uint256,address), withdraw and redeem; exact current implementation instead has operator mint(address,uint256), deposit and no ordinary withdraw/redeem. SDK Manager requestRedemption example omits deployed fifth bytes32 referralCode argument. Exact deployed ABI is authoritative.
sourceSemantics.underlyingMismatch: Current explorer asset() is PRISM (18 decimals), not USDC or a generic stablecoin. Current name is YieldFi OpenEden. Official legal terms remain as observed, not a guarantee of current settlement configuration.
